stops.note: to take thoroughly, to grasp mentally, from per- (thoroughly) and capere (to take)
carried into French for becoming aware of something through the senses
stops.meaning: to become aware of through the senses

stops.note: settled as the English word for becoming aware of something through senses or the mind
stops.meaning: to become aware of something through the senses or mind

current_meaning: to become aware of something through the senses, or to interpret it in a certain way
